title: Arise Tier Tagger
description: A Minecraft Fabric mod that displays player PvP tiers from Arise TierList directly in their nametags.
body:
# 🏷️ Arise Tier Tagger

**The official nametag-tiering mod!**

Developed by **[Divya Prakash Mishra](https://d1vya.netlify.app/)** • Officially supported by **[arisetierlist.netlify.app](https://arisetierlist.netlify.app/)**

---

## 🛠️ Dependencies

> **⚠️ IMPORTANT:** This mod requires the following dependencies to function properly:
> * **[ukulib](https://modrinth.com/mod/ukulib)**
> * **[Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)**

---

## ✨ Features

* **Nametag Tiers:** Displays a player's PvP Tier directly in their nametag.
* **Full Game Mode Support:** Supports all 8 Arise Tier List game modes.
* **Expanded Tierlists:** Other tierlists (such as the *AriseSub Tierlist*) are fully supported as of version 2.0!
* **Smart Fallbacks:** The default game mode to display is entirely configurable. If a player is unranked in your specified game mode, TierTagger will automatically display their highest overall Tier instead.
* **Profile Viewer:** Includes a sleek, built-in system to view detailed player profiles on the fly!

---

## 📅 Minecraft Version Support

* **Currently Supported:** Minecraft `1.21` through `1.21.11`
* **Future Version Support:** Once Mojang transitions to the new versioning system, Tier Tagger will actively support the last 4 minor releases. During this transition phase (until version `26.4`), versions `1.21.1` and `1.21.11` will remain fully supported.
